mike_support: urgent escalation from NovaMed pilot — they're blocked on go-live (T-3 days). Two issues: SSO failing for a subset of users (401 on SAML assertion) and embedding quality has regressed on their anchor set (~0.6 -> ~0.42). Customer quote: "search results are noise". They've opened ticket #78942. Need CS comms plan + priority handling. @jess_cs can you own outreach? :rotating_light:

jess_cs: acknowledging, thanks @mike_support. Is this P1 for the account? Renewal touchpoint in ~6 weeks — pilot success drives that decision. I'll own comms if we make a clear plan.

mike_support: marking as P1. Reproducer + logs attached to the ticket. Quick log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T08:12:03Z ERROR auth: SAML assertion expired for user id=nm-42
embedding_sim: 0.42 (expected ~0.6) // anchor set avg
request_id: r-0a1b2c3d
```
They tried reauth, same result. Also noted token expiration spikes when sequence length > 512.

arlo_se: I'll pick up the technical triage. Immediate checks: (1) kernel/quantization mismatch if we rolled a new variant, (2) tokenization differences for SSO payload length, (3) infra time sync for SAML. Can you DM me the reproducer command and request_id?

mike_support: reproducer (in ticket): `python reproduce_novamed.py --request r-0a1b2c3d --samples 50`

vivian_csm: I'll take customer comms. Proposed plan: short proactive note + action timeline + internal owner list. Draft I want to send to NovaMed in 30m:
> Hi Team — thanks for flagging this. We're treating this as a high priority. Our engineer will triage immediately; we propose a short call tomorrow 11:30 PT to walk through reproducer and next steps. Meanwhile we can rollback the embed model or pin to previous variant if needed. Expect hourly updates until resolved.

Can I get thumbs on that? I don't want to overpromise a fix before we know root cause.

jess_cs: +1 on tone. Add explicit ask: "Can you share a minimal failing example and any recent config changes on your side?" Also note we'll pause the renewal presentation until pilot is green.

taylor_pm: I'm assigning an ops engineer to start an eval run on the anchor set now, will prioritize if it's a model/regression. If it's infra (tokenization/time sync), that'll be lower lift. ETA for initial findings: 6 hours. If we confirm regression, I'll open a hotfix branch and aim for next-24h patch.

mike_support: customer asked about temporary mitigations — is rollback to `redwood-embed-v2-quant` safe as a stopgap?

arlo_se: rollback is acceptable short-term. Two caveats: we should run a quick smoke eval and watch latency. I'll run the eval and report back.

ops_bot: Ticket #78942 created and severity set to P1. Pager notified. Linked SRE runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-regression

vivian_csm: Action items so far:
- Vivian: send proactive note + schedule 11:30 PT call (tomorrow)
- Arlo: triage reproducer and run smoke eval on `redwood-embed-v2-quant` (ETA 3h)
- Taylor: run anchor-set regression eval (ETA 6h) and prepare hotfix branch if confirmed
- Mike: keep ticket updates + ask customer for minimal failing example and any config changes
- Jess: own renewal comms pause decision and update CSM roster

jess_cs: Thanks all. Please post quick status updates here as you have them. If we confirm regression, I'll prepare a customer-facing remediation timeline and an internal postmortem owner. :pray:

mike_support: will update ticket in the next 30m with reproducer link + sample failing doc.
